001package org.clafer.collection;
002
003import java.util.Iterator;
004import org.clafer.common.Check;
005
006/**
007 *
008 * @author jimmy
009 * @param <T> the type of elements returned by this iterator
010 */
011public class ArrayIterator<T> implements Iterator<T> {
012
013    private final T[] array;
014    private int index;
015    private final int to;
016
017    public ArrayIterator(T[] array) {
018        this(array, 0, array.length);
019    }
020
021    /**
022     * Iterate an array in order starting in position from (inclusive) and
023     * ending in position to (exclusive).
024     *
025     * @param array iterate this array
026     * @param from start iterating from this index
027     * @param to stop before this index
028     */
029    public ArrayIterator(T[] array, int from, int to) {
030        if (to < from) {
031            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
032        }
033        if (from < 0) {
034            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
035        }
036        if (to > array.length) {
037            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
038        }
039        this.array = Check.notNull(array);
040        this.index = from;
041        this.to = to;
042    }
043
044    @Override
045    public boolean hasNext() {
046        return index < to;
047    }
048
049    @Override
050    public T next() {
051        return array[index++];
052    }
053
054    /**
055     * Not supported.
056     *
057     * @throws UnsupportedOperationException if invoked
058     */
059    @Override
060    public void remove() throws UnsupportedOperationException {
061        throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
062    }
063}
